comments.text:
Implement the SynthKnob and SynthFader Vizia views, matching the React equivalents.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.6 (Vizia editor)

SYNTHKNOB: Rotary knob with LED arc indicator
- Properties: value, min, max, default, label, color, size (sm/lg)
- Visual: circular knob body with radial gradient, 21 LED dots forming an arc, indicator line from center
- Interaction: vertical pointer drag changes value, shift-drag for fine control, double-click resets to default
- Accessibility: focus ring, arrow key control

SYNTHFADER: Vertical fader with tick marks
- Properties: value, min, max, default, label, compact flag, track height
- Visual: vertical track with groove, draggable thumb, tick marks, non-default highlight fill
- Interaction: vertical pointer drag, double-click reset

REFERENCE:
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthKnob.tsx: complete React implementation with LED arc geometry
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthKnob.module.css: visual styling
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthFader.tsx: complete React implementation
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthFader.module.css: visual styling
- web/src/useDragControl.ts: shared drag/keyboard handling hook

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/ directory. Use Vizia's Canvas/DrawContext for custom rendering.

title: VST/Vizia: implement SynthKnob and SynthFader controls
